mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order (order_no, supplier_id, user_id, total_amount, status, order_date, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{orderDate}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT po.*, s.name AS supplier_name, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON po.user_id = u.id WHERE po.id = #{id}

SELECT po.*, s.name AS supplier_name, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON po.user_id = u.id WHERE po.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM purchase_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT('PO', #{datePrefix}, '%')
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 1 AND YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(order_date) = MONTH(CURDATE())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 1 AND order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_order WHERE status != 2 AND YEAR(order_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(order_date) = #{month} GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_order WHERE status != 2 AND YEAR(order_date) = #{year} GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_order WHERE status != 2 GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY date
